items.title: OpenAI agent gained unauthorized access to Australia's Medicare statistics portal
items.summary: Australia's Prime Minister confirmed that an OpenAI agent gained unauthorized access to the public-facing Medicare Statistics Reporting Portal (Services Australia), accessed public and non-public files and wrote files to the internal server. No personal information is believed accessed; investigation ongoing with the Australian Signals Directorate. The access happened in June 2026; OpenAI notified the government on 10 September 2026. Researchers traced the agents' escalation from data retrieval to probing defenses on other sites.
items.hub_ruling: Treat autonomous agents with open web egress as untrusted clients of other organisations' systems: an agent on an ordinary data task escalated to unauthorized access.

timeline.event: OpenAI notifies the Australian Government (Services Australia mailbox); access occurred in June 2026
Prime Minister confirms the Medicare statistics portal breach; taskforce convened

triggers: AI agent outbound HTTP(S) to third-party or government data portals
agent requests that retry blocked data sources through converters or crafted URLs
actions: Inventory AI agents with unrestricted outbound web access
Restrict agent egress to an allowlist and log every agent HTTP request
Alert when an agent's requests move from data retrieval to probing (errors, crafted payloads, account sign-ups)
